articles.title: Martin Odegaard, Kai Havertz and Bukayo Saka show Arsenal can level up their attack even without the blockbuster signing they craved
articles.summary: Arsenal missed out on Morgan Rogers, Vinicius Junior and Julian Alvarez during the summer transfer window but Martin Odegaard, Kai Havertz and Bukayo Saka are fit and firing again; champions beat Chelsea 2-1 to claim third straight Premier League win
articles.body:
The Chelsea goalkeeper managed to push his effort around the post. But the slick passage of play was one of many examples of how the champions, on maximum points after a third straight win, are feeling the benefits of having the trio available again.

Much of the focus ahead of the game had fallen on Chelsea's front three. How would Arsenal contain Joao Pedro, Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer? It seemed the script had been written when Rogers stunned the ground into silence after 77 seconds.

But Arsenal regained their poise and proved a point about their own attack. Rogers was one of three high-profile forwards to elude them during the summer along with Vinicius Junior and Julian Alvarez. But they may still have the tools to level up without them.

Latest news and rumours: Chelsea | Arsenal

The key is simply to get their best attackers on the pitch, something injuries prevented for much of the last two seasons. This was the first time since December 2024 that Odegaard, Havertz and Saka have started a third straight league game together.

Odegaard and Havertz made the decisive contributions, combining for the winner when the former finished coolly following the latter's dummy. Earlier, Havertz had equalised with his precise finish at Martinez's near post from the edge of the box.

"They have been Arsenal's two best players," said Sky Sports pundit Gary Neville when they were substituted to loud applause. Saka wasn't bad either, tearing into Chelsea on the right and earning a standing ovation of his own later in the second half.

The clamour for Arsenal to add a forward was of course understandable. The club's efforts, although ultimately fruitless, showed they appreciate the need for it. In an ideal world they would have marquee attacking signing leading them into this season.

But they can go at least some way to making up the shortfall by keeping Odegaard, Havertz and Saka fit. The last time they managed it over the course of a full season, in 2023/24, they finished the campaign with a club-record 91 Premier League goals.

It helps that Odegaard has rediscovered his scoring touch.

Their captain is unrecognisable from the player who only scored once in 36 games last term. His winner puts him on three in four for the new campaign; his latest another example, following a nearly-identical goal in the Community Shield, of how he is getting into the box more. Arteta noted other differences.

"He's fit, and confidence-wise I think it's one of the highest that I've seen him," he said. "He also has a point to prove from last season after missing so much football, and Bukayo the same. We missed so many attacking players last season for long, long periods."

His chemistry with both Saka and Havertz is another factor. They were the two players he passed to most against Chelsea. Odegaard found Saka 10 times and Havertz seven. But his understanding with both, the latter in particular, extends to off-the-ball runs too.

"He's a really smart player and moves so well," Odegaard told Sky Sports of Havertz. "He takes defenders' attention. When he makes the run and I come from behind, I'm always free."

Arteta agreed. "When you start to feel the chemistry they have between them and what they can produce, it's great," he added. "For me, he gets to that point because he's enjoying his football.

"And when you are there, you have to enjoy what you do, you have to play with real intent, and that's what I loved to see from him today. He was running forward, he took shots, he created so many situations for his team-mates, so it was great."

Havertz, also on three goals in four games, has been similarly impactful. This was another all-round performance to underline just how much he gives the side, as an aerial outlet and runner in behind who links with his midfielders and works incessantly.

"To displace Havertz from this team, you need to be one of the best players in the world," said Sky Sports pundit Jamie Carragher.

Three Premier League games in, Odegaard, Havertz and Saka account for all six of Arsenal's goals. But the performance against Chelsea showed it has been a collective endeavour too.

As against Coventry and Aston Villa, Arsenal appeared notably more fluid in the final third, with Havertz often pulling to the right, Saka popping up centrally or even swapping flanks with Christos Tzolis, and Riccardo Calafiori appearing everywhere.

"It was another layer," added Arteta to Sky Sports . "Another layer of dynamism, of threat, of intent, of aggression in the attacking phase. You have certainly seen that today."

Chelsea struggled to cope with the level of movement. Even before the second goal, Arsenal had got in behind their backline repeatedly, their combinations, usually in the right half-space, where Odegaard and Saka, in particular, do their best work, proving problematic.

The challenge now is to keep them fit. A spate of injuries like those suffered in the last two seasons might leave fans pining for that blockbuster signing again. But for now they can enjoy what they have. Odegaard, Havertz and Saka are leading their charge.

articles.title: Hace un mes nadie se lo habría creído
articles.standfirst: La contracrónica de Valencia-Barcelona
articles.summary: La contracrónica de Valencia-Barcelona
articles.body: Había cierto temor en Can Barça antes de iniciarse la temporada por el poder ofensivo que iba a ofrecer en esta temporada. No en vano, habían dejado el equipo tres jugadores claves en este aspecto como eran Lewandowski, Ferran y Rashford. Entre los tres habían anotado 54 goles en el pasado ejercicio. Para igualarlos los delanteros azulgrana tendrían que espabilar. Cuando llevamos cuatro jornadas de Liga ya nadie se acuerda de esos tres. El Barça vive de goleada en goleada y ya está en los más alto de la clasificación y en solitario. El Barça tiene una media goleadora de más de cuatro tantos por partido. Y lo curioso del tema es que los sustitutos no han sido los artífices de los goles. El tridente ofensivo del Barcelona lo forman Raphinha, Lamine Yamal y Fermín. Son una máquina de hacer goles. En Mestalla estos tres se dieron un festival y abrieron la lata en perfecta combinación. Y pudieron ser más porque el Barça fue un vendaval ofensivo y pudo marcar muchos más. Dimitrievski, el mejor del rival. Lo dicho si se lo cuentan hace un mes, nadie se lo cree. Anthony Gordon ha llegado sin hacer mucho ruido. Ha sido el fichaje silencioso que ha ido entrando en el equipo poco a poco. Todavía no ha marcado ninguno, pero con la de Mestalla ha dado cuatro asistencias a su compañero. Y pudieron ser más porque dio otro balón de gol a Lamine, pero su remate lo sacó Dimitrievski. El británico ha entrado con muy buen pie en el equipo Muy mala suerte la de Eric García en Valencia. El hecho de tener que retirarse lesionado siempre es duro para un jugador. Pero si el golpe te lo da un compañero en vez de un rival es mucho más duro. Es lo que sucedió en un córner cuando Rodri hizo un giro inesperado y le dio un cabezazo a Eric García que tuvo que irse. Joan García ya empieza a hacer de las suyas. Si el poder ofensivo del Barcelona es brutal, cerrar la portería también es clave para conseguir los éxitos. En Mestalla, otra vez la portería a cero. El Barcelona lo ha conseguido en tres de los cuatro partidos disputados. Clave para ser el líder. En la primera parte le sacó dos a Danjuma que podrían haber cambiado el partido. Aunque para pulpo: Dimitrievski. SI no es por él al Valencia la cae un carro. Rodri salió por primera vez de titular. Y confirmó lo que todos sabían, que es un jugador que va a dar muchísimo al Barcelona. Fue un espectáculo. Es el director de juego azulgrana, pero cuando hace falta es un central más que ayuda dentro del área; o roba el balón clave que luego se convierte en el tercer gol; o juega de extremo y llega a la línea de fondo para dar un pase. Un futbolista total. Gabriel Jesus debutó con el Barcelona. Flick le dio diez minutos y entró en lugar de Pedri. Y se colocó como delantero centro. Raphinha cambió de posición y se fue a la media punta. Se le vio con ganas y tuvo una ocasión para marcar.

articles.title: Arsenal claim derby honours v Chelsea, Everton level late v Man Utd
articles.summary: Arsenal needed to come from behind to win a breathless game 2-1 against Chelsea at the Emirates Stadium as Kai Havertz scored for the third time in the Premi...
articles.body:
Arsenal needed to come from behind to win a breathless game 2-1 against Chelsea at the Emirates Stadium as Kai Havertz scored for the third time in the Premier League against his former club.

Havertz netted midway through the first half to equalise after Morgan Rogers, who the champions missed out on signing during the transfer window, had stunned home fans with a volleyed goal after 77 seconds.

The Germany international was instrumental too in Martin Odegaard's 50th-minute winner, executing a delightful dummy to leave Chelsea's defence flatfooted and create room for the captain to rifle home.

Chelsea had lost four league games in a row at the Emirates, conceding 11 goals, but here they gave Arsenal a far sterner examination than at any time during that sequence, with the front three of Cole Palmer, Joao Pedro and Rogers again showing their potential as assets in a possible title challenge.

Yet Xabi Alonso appeared no closer to solving the enigma of a team so irresistible in attack yet too easily pulled into all the wrong shapes defensively and in midfield.

In truth, Arsenal's play and Chelsea's wobbles ought to have brought victory by a larger margin, Emiliano Martinez with a wonderful stop to deny Bukayo Saka, before David Raya gave a reminder of his own indispensability with an even better save to keep out Estevao.

Earlier, Ainsley Maitland-Niles scored a dream stoppage-time equaliser on his Everton debut to earn a 2-2 draw against Manchester United and lift the mood at the end of a difficult week.

Deadline day ended in disappointment for fans of both clubs but the Toffees' inaction was particularly concerning given Tuesday's botched business left them with a threadbare squad and an unhappy manager.

David Moyes admitted he had "to live with disappointments" and called for Everton players to "muck in", but Sunday looked set to end in further frustration after substitute Benjamin Sesko's 88th-minute header put United on course for a late victory.

Tyrique George's thunderous strike had cancelled out a fine Bryan Mbeumo effort moments earlier but the Slovenia international would not prove United's match-winning substitute for the second time at Hill Dickinson Stadium this year.

Instead, deadline-day acquisition Maitland-Niles came off the bench to rifle home from distance to snatch a dramatic late point and spark bedlam.

articles.body:
Manchester City will clash heads with Porto at the Estadio do Dragao this Tuesday night as they look to secure a win in the UEFA Champions League. The Mancunian giants managed to secure a narrow 1-0 win over Coventry City recently, which should keep them in good spirits going into this game.

Enzo Maresca will opt for the 4-2-3-1 formation and is expected to make a few changes to his first team for this clash. Rico Lewis, Nico O'Reilly and Phil Foden could all play from the start of this game.

4-2-3-1 Manchester City Predicted Lineup To Face Porto

Gianluigi Donnarumma will operate in between the sticks for Man City after keeping a clean sheet in his last outing. Ruben Dias will continue to function alongside Marc Guehi at the centre of Maresca's defence as they look to keep a good shape on the defensive end of the field.

Rico Lewis will fill in as the right-back, while Josko Gvardiol hopes to prove his worth on the other side as the left-back. Both of them will get the freedom to go forward and express themselves inside the opponent's half.

Abdukodir Khusanov will offer cover for the defensive positions on the bench.

MANCHESTER, ENGLAND – SEPTEMBER 05: Antoine Semenyo of Manchester City during the Premier League 2026/27 match between Manchester City and Coventry City at Etihad Stadium on September 05, 2026 in Manchester, England. (Photo by Carl Recine/Getty Images)

Nico O'Reilly and Elliot Anderson will anchor the midfield for Man City as they try to win the 50-50 battles at the centre of the park and engineer some decent chances in the final third.

The gifted trio of Phil Foden, Rayan Cherki and Antoine Semenyo will operate just ahead of them as part of the Man City attack. All three of them need to be at their best if the Mancunian club are to secure a victory at the Estadio do Dragao in midweek.

Iliman Ndiaye and Enzo Fernandez will be available for selection on the bench and might come on to influence the game in the second half if required.

Erling Haaland will spearhead Man City 's attack up top. He managed to score the winning goal against Coventry City, which should give him a ton of confidence ahead of this game.

Ryan McAiddo will have to settle for a spot on the bench as he waits for his chance to make an impact in the latter stages of the game if needed.

articles.title: Livingston dismiss manager Whelan after nine games
articles.summary: Livingston sack Glenn Whelan after just nine games, with David Martindale returning to the head coach position on a temporary basis.
articles.body:
Livingston have sacked Glenn Whelan after just nine games, with David Martindale returning to the head coach position on a temporary basis.

Former Republic of Ireland international Whelan, 42, was appointed in May following the West Lothian club's relegation from the Scottish Premiership.

He leaves with Livingston fifth in the Scottish Championship after two wins and three defeats.

There were two wins two draws in the Premier Sports Cup.

On announcing the end of Whelan's brief reign, Calvin Ford, the West Lothian club's American owner and chairman said: "Our net will be cast far wider than it was in our previous search, and the focus of the search will be via data analytics.

"Mediocrity is not an acceptable solution, and we will continue to work to find the leader that delivers on the ambitions and aspirations of sustained, high-level success that we expect at Livingston."

Frankie McAvoy will join Martindale as an interim coach, with the duo assisted by Grant Murray and Brian Potter.

Martindale ended his six-year stint as manager in January, moving into a sporting director role, while Marvin Bartley stepped down after relegation was confirmed and a dismal top flight campaign ended with Scott Arfield as player-boss for the last three games.

Bartley's Stenhousemuir were 1-0 winners away to Livingston on Friday.

"Davie's past success and proven track record in the Scottish Championship made this decision easy, and we look forward to refocusing and finding success on the pitch while he holds this position," added Ford.

articles.title: ElPozo Murcia conquista su séptima Supercopa tras asaltar el Palau Blaugrana
articles.standfirst: Los de Josan González vuelven a ganar un título nueve años después de la Copa del Rey de 2017
articles.summary: Los de Josan González vuelven a ganar un título nueve años después de la Copa del Rey de 2017
articles.body: ElPozo Murcia levantó su séptima Supercopa de España, rompiendo el empate que tenían los murcianos tras 12 finales jugadas y seis ganadas, tras imponerse al F. C. Barcelona en el Palau Blau Grana (5-4). 3.410 días después del último, los de Josan González vuelven conquistar un título y ya son 22 (nacionales e internacionales) los que lucirán en las vitrinas de la entidad charcutera. Dos de las incorporaciones para esta temporada, Gonzalo Santa Cruz y Pachu, gallegos ambos, plasmaron en goles la mejor puesta en escena de los de Josan González, que se encontraron con dos goles de ventaja cuando se había consumido apenas la primera mitad de los 20 minutos iniciales. Con la firmeza de Antonio Navarro y las continuas llegadas de jugadores a las inmediaciones del área de Dídac Plana, los murcianos daban cierta sensación de tener controlado el partido. Sin embargo, el Barça estaba muy vivo y Eric Martel consiguió reducir al mínimo la diferencia rival. En el segundo tiempo, se vivió un escenario similar. Marcel volvió a elevar la diferencia murciana a dos goles, pero nunca dio la sensación de que el partido estaba resuelto. Tanto que, pese a que Pito no exhibió el mayor acierto ante la meta de Antonio Navarro, fue Joao Victor quien se encargó en una gran jugada de pívot y asistiendo a Adolfo de establecer el 3-3. Apenas dos minutos tardó en llegar la reacción murciana y fue Marcel, el hombre más inspirado este fin de semana en Barcelona, quien tuvo la paciencia para poner el 4-3. Lo volvió a intentar el Barça ya con Catela como portero jugador. Sin embargo, en una acción en la que Pito no consiguió batir a Antonio Navarro, Gadeia marcó a puerta vacía. Persistieron los azulgranas y Catela acortó diferencias con 11 segundos aún por disputarse. FICHA TÉCNICA ElPozo Murcia: Antonio Navarro; Ricardinho, Gadeia, Marcel y Dener. articles.title: El Castellón hurga en la herida del Albacete y se sitúa como nuevo líder
articles.standfirst: Con Ousmane Camara de protagonista, goleador y asistente, doblega a un cuadro manchego que sigue sin puntuar tras cuatro jornadas
articles.summary: Con Ousmane Camara de protagonista, goleador y asistente, doblega a un cuadro manchego que sigue sin puntuar tras cuatro jornadas
articles.body: Con dos goles en apenas seis minutos de la segunda parte y un Ousmane Camara como gran protagonista, goleador y asistente, el Castellón no sólo doblegó al Albacete, al que superó claramente de principio a fin, sino que celebra su primer triunfo en Castalia, sigue invicto y acabará la jornada al frente de la clasificación. Por contra, el cuadro manchego sufre su cuarta derrota en otros tantos partidos. El Castellón empezó con fuerza llegando con peligro por partida doble en los dos primeros minutos por medio de Íñigo Córdoba y Fran Castillo. Los albinegros dominaban ante un Albacete que buscaba sorprender en las transiciones. Y estuvo a punto de lograrlo Mario Soberón en un disparo que detuvo Matthys. Pero los de Pablo Hernández también pudieron marcar poco después, a la media hora, pues fruto de la insistencia 'orellut' llegó la ocasión más clara, un jugadón del equipo culminado con un regate seco y un disparo potente Ousmane Camara que salió rozando el poste. El Albacete, con dos cambios en el descanso, pareció nivelar el duelo en la reanudación, sin embargo el Castellón imprimió una marcha más para romper la resistencia de su rival y llevarse el partido. Así, en una ráfaga de seis minutos cerró el choque con dos goles. Primero Ousmane Camara remató a placer una gran acción de Fran Castillo prolongada de tacón por Pablo Santiago y a renglón seguido el delantero guineano filtró un gran pase y el recién ingresado Suero superó a Mariño con gran sutileza. No superó ese doble golpe el equipo de Alberto González ante un Castellón que pudo ampliar la renta con tres llegadas claras de Juanjo Nieto, a quien Mariño le negó el gol, de Suero, que se topó de nuevo con el meta visitante y el poste en los mejores minutos albinegros, y de Camara, a quien Lluis López le negó el doblete lanzándose al suelo.

articles.title: Mucho trabajo por hacer
articles.standfirst: Málaga y Levante se quedan a cero dejando la sensación de que quieren más de lo que pueden
articles.summary: Málaga y Levante se quedan a cero dejando la sensación de que quieren más de lo que pueden
articles.body: Llegaba el Málaga con ciertas necesidades tras haber sumado un punto en tres jornadas. Su calendario no había sido sencillo, pero ante el Levante, un equipo que llegaba con buenas sensaciones pero que es de sus rivales por la salvación, fue más el querer que el poder. Los de Funes mostraron más ganas que un Levante al que siempre pareció que el empate no le iba mal. Y tuvieron ocasiones para ganar. Pero hace falta algo más y, de momento, no lo tienen. Su fútbol refleja que, si se quitan esa presión por ganar, pueden ir hacia arriba. Pero esto es Primera. Tocará sudar. El Levante, en cambio, es un equipo más hecho, más trabajado. Y, por lo tanto, se le puede exigir más de lo que hizo en La Rosaleda. También tienen cosas que pulir. Aun así, un punto a domicilio seguro que les supo bien. Al minuto pudo inaugurar el marcador el Levante tras un error en la salida de balón del Málaga que no supo aprovechar Thiago. Herrero le salió y tapó bien el remate. También pudo hacerlo pronto el Málaga desde los once metros por una mano de Nacho Pérez, pero Ryan no se movió y adivinó la intención de Chupe. En el rechace anotó el conjunto blanquiazul. Sin embargo, el colegiado lo anuló por una discutida falta a Dela. El Málaga dominaba claramente, no dejando al Levante casi actuar en su campo. Y se acercaba siempre con peligro al área granota. Como Larrubia, que a punto estuvo de firmar un gol de bandera tras varios recortes. Le falló la dirección del disparo. Pese a los intentos malacitanos, no hubo goles en la primera mitad. Y fue el Levante el que comenzó creando peligro en la segunda. La más clara, la de Nacho Pérez, que se encontró con los reflejos de Herrero en una de las paradas en lo que llevamos de Liga. Fue la señal de que el equipo de Funes había perdido el control del partido y cedido terreno. Por eso movió el banquillo y las entradas de Puga y Joaquín, que buscó el penalti en un piscinazo, les dio un nuevo aire. Sin embargo, las ocasiones no terminaron de llegar. Al Levante no le importó y al Málaga le puso nervioso. Las necesidades empiezan a apretar. Hay trabajo por hacer.

articles.title: Lucas Boyé se lleva el premio en la 'Feria del delantero antiguo' de Vitoria
articles.standfirst: El Alavés suma diez puntos y sólo tiene al Barça por delante en la clasificación
articles.summary: El Alavés suma diez puntos y sólo tiene al Barça por delante en la clasificación
articles.body: Mendizorroza acogió este domingo la 'Feria del delantero antiguo', una exhibición de atacantes clásicos en la que Lucas Boyé, con tres goles, se llevó el primer premio por delante de Ante Budimir, dos tantos, y de su compañero Mariano. A base de misiles, el equipo de Quique sigue en una nube y sólo el Barcelona ha sido capaz de sumar más puntos en estas cuatro primeras jornadas. Fue un partido hecho a medida de los delanteros desde el primer instante. Budimir tiró un gran desmarque, corrió al área, dejó sentado a Koski con un recorte precioso y Sivera tuvo que sacar una gran mano para evitar el gol. También pudo llegar el primero en la otra portería unos minutos después, pero Boyomo arregló lo que había emborronado Sergio Herrera con un mal despeje y evitó sobre la línea el tanto del Alavés. Pero aquí habíamos venido a ver goles y Boyé abrió el escaparate. Mariano ganó un salto, tocó el balón y el argentino soltó un zapatazo imposible para Sergio Herrera. Osasuna no reaccionó al gol, bajó los brazos y Catena tuvo un segundo de duda en el peor momento, con Mariano corriendo hacia él, que es como dudar en la jaula del cocodrilo. Hace un mes se daba a Mariano por amortizado. Después de tantos años de resurrecciones frustradas, de lesiones y desengaños, el fútbol estaba listo para soltarle la mano y dejarle ir. Y de repente, a 6 de septiembre, tras cuatro jornadas, Mariano lleva tres goles, tres asistencias y tiene al Alavés segundo con diez puntos. Y con una actitud que no hace pensar que esto sea un espejismo. ¿Hay un balón suelto? Mariano corre a por él como un niño detrás del camión de los helados. ¿Hay un duelo aéreo? Mariano salta para ganarlo, como en el 1-0. ¿Hay un central que duda en el despeje? Mariano lo aprovecha para plantarse ante el portero y marcar, como en el 2-0. Ajustadito al palo, sin perdón. Osasuna se fue al descanso con mala cara, pero Budimir volvió del vestuario con ganas de presentar su candidatura al concurso. No había pasado ni medio minuto cuando el croata se hizo enorme en el área para cabecear al fondo de la red el 2-1 y dar unas esperanzas a los suyos que Boyé ventiló, en cinco minutos, con otro cañonazo desde todavía más lejos que el primero que se coló cerquita de la escuadra rojilla. La dinámica se repitió diez minutos después. Abde derribó a Budimir en el área porque no tenía otra forma de marcarle y el croata no falló desde el punto de penalti para hacer su cuarto gol de la temporada. Y a los cinco minutos, cabezazo picado de Lucas Boyé para completar la tarjeta de sellos del hat-trick y asegurarse el gran premio de la tarde. El equipo de Ramis no fue capaz de volver a levantarse del golpe y encajó la primera derrota de la temporada ante un Alavés al que aún le faltaba un último grito, el del gol de Pablo Ibáñez en el 90', un gol de un centrocampista... entrando como un '9' a cabecear al fondo de la red. Una oda al delantero clásico hasta el final.

articles.title: Manuel Neuer targeted by X-rated chants from boyhood home crowd as Bayern issue furious response
articles.summary: Football News: Manuel Neuer's return to Schalke was marred by hostile reception and X-rated chants as Bayern Munich's goalkeeper reflects on his emotional homecoming. Schalke's fans express resentment over his departure to Bayern in 2011, while Bayern's sporting director calls out the unacceptable behavior from a section of the home crowd.
articles.body: Manuel Neuer returned to the club where he spent his entire childhood and much of his career on Saturday, but his homecoming was anything but peaceful.The Bayern Munich goalkeeper was met with relentless boos and whistles during the 0-0 draw at Schalke, with sections of the home crowd going even further as old resentment over his 2011 departure resurfaced.Neuer targeted throughout Bayern's goalless drawNeuer started between the posts as Bayern dominated possession at the Veltins-Arena, recording 15 shots and 83 per cent possession but failing to find a way past Schalke.Vincent Kompany's side also started without Harry Kane, who was named on the bench before replacing left-back Nathaniel Brown at half-time. The introductions of Michael Olise and Jamal Musiala early in the second half also failed to change the result.For Neuer, though, the attention was rarely on what was happening on the pitch.The 40-year-old was booed and whistled by Schalke supporters almost every time he touched the ball, while sections of the crowd directed X-rated chants towards their former goalkeeper.Neuer's connection with Schalke runs exceptionally deep.He joined the club's academy at the age of five, came through the youth ranks and spent more than two decades there before leaving for Bayern in 2011.Before establishing himself as Schalke's first-choice goalkeeper, Neuer even watched matches from the North Stand, where the club's ultras are based.His eventual move to Bayern caused considerable anger among Schalke supporters at the time.Schalke were firmly established in the Bundesliga and had qualified for the 2011/12 Europa League after winning the DFB-Pokal. They would go on to finish in the Champions League qualification places the following season.But the clubs have rarely had the chance to revisit that rivalry in recent years. Schalke have spent four of the past five seasons in the 2. Bundesliga, only returning to the top flight after winning the second-tier title last season.Their return brought Neuer back to Gelsenkirchen, and made clear that some supporters have not forgotten how he left.The abuse did not appear to affect him.Asked about the chants after the match, Neuer offered a surprisingly light-hearted response.“Those are compliments, that's love. Every boo, even when I touched the ball, was a compliment,” he told Sky.He later added: “It was nice to come back. I spent 20 years here, and I learned everything here. My family lives here. I really enjoyed it.”Bayern chief draws the line over Neuer abuseBayern sporting director Max Eberl took a very different view of the reaction.While he praised the vast majority of Schalke supporters, he was furious about the abuse directed at Neuer.“Schalke fans, 95 per cent, chapeau for what they have done,” Eberl said after the match.But he had little sympathy for those responsible for the offensive chants.“The other ... they should be proud that they produced such a great guy in their youth academy, who then made the breakthrough into world football, became the best goalkeeper in the world and a world champion.”Eberl's message was that Schalke supporters had every right to make their feelings known about Bayern.“Then such expletives are not acceptable. You can boo because you are against Bayern, but there is no need for those expressions.”He later reiterated the point, saying: “They should be proud that they developed such a great player in their academy, who then went on to take steps into world football and become the world's best goalkeeper and a world champion. Those kinds of insults are simply not appropriate.”There was also tension before kick-off.According to BILD, Bayern's ultras and Schalke supporters clashed in a car park before the match got underway, adding another layer to an already heated occasion.For Neuer, however, the evening ultimately remained a sentimental one despite everything directed towards him.He signed a new one-year contract with Bayern and has continued as their first-choice goalkeeper this season, but Saturday's trip to Schalke may have been his final appearance at the stadium where his career began.He did not allow the reception to overshadow that.“I played here for more than 20 years,” Neuer said. “It was a very emotional day and something very special.”The Schalke supporters may still regard his decision to join Bayern as a betrayal.Neuer, judging by his reaction, simply saw it as a very noisy homecoming.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Women's Super League: New contenders emerge - but Manchester City start strong
articles.summary: The Women’s Super League returned this weekend and with it a host of new signings, improved squads and unexpected results.
articles.body:
The Women’s Super League returned this weekend and with it a host of new signings, improved squads and unexpected results.

Manchester City began the defence of their title with victory at home to newly-promoted Birmingham City, while underdogs Crystal Palace upset Everton.

But which clubs made a statement and do Manchester City look like title favourites again?

Find interviews and extra content on the BBC Women's Football Weekly feed

As is the case with any new season, an early look at title challengers does not give the whole story but can be a good marker of who has the right credentials.

There were debuts for big-name signings Ona Batlle and Georgia Stanway at Arsenal, while Katie McCabe swapped red for blue when she started for Chelsea.

Manchester City also had new faces off the bench as they navigated an injury-hit squad on opening weekend.

But the reigning champions could not have hoped for a better start as they hosted WSL 2 winners Birmingham at the Joie Stadium and cruised to a 3-1 victory .

It was an assured display, full of the attacking flair and threat they unleashed last season with the only criticism that they should have scored more.

Birmingham City were no pushovers and performed well on their return to the top flight, but Andree Jeglertz’s side still imposed their superiority.

The Swedish boss was delighted with victory, though the perfectionist in him wanted more after a "hesitant" first half.

"In the first half, it was almost [like we were] getting into it again. We turned it around and the second half was much smoother," said Jeglertz.

"It's about driving the game and we did that. Even though we scored goals, we wanted more."

New season, same flaw - Chelsea title hopes already under scrutiny

Manchester City did what Chelsea could not as Sonia Bompastor's side were held to a frustrating 1-1 draw by Aston Villa at Stamford Bridge.

Despite 57 touches in the opposition box, 23 shots inside the area, an effort that hit the crossbar and a disallowed goal for offside, Chelsea could not break Villa down.

Their lack of ruthlessness was a consistent characteristic last season as Chelsea, who had won the previous six WSL titles, fell to third in the table.

Their opening display did little to ease concerns it would be a similar story this season, while City showed they remain a serious force to overcome.

Elsewhere, the bookies' favourites to win the league, Arsenal, did not find life easy at Brighton for their opening game.

Arturo Ruiz, 29, took charge of his first match for Albion - a side many think can challenge the WSL's giants - and they made life tough for the Gunners.

A moment of quality from 19-year-old Lisa Baum on her Arsenal debut won the points in a 1-0 victory and, while unconvincing, it remains early days.

Last season's Champions League quarter-finalists Manchester United did not get off to a good start under manager Eva Olid as they were beaten by a surprisingly fluid display from opponents London City Lionesses on Friday.

The team of superstars, boosted by new signings such as two-time Ballon d'Or winner Alexia Putellas and Spain defender Mapi Leon, lived up to the hype on the opening night to pick up a well-earned 2-1 win .

They had 60% possession and 11 shots - not bad for a team who have barely got to know each other during a high-turnover summer.

While they clearly have bags of talent, there was scepticism at how quickly London City would gel, but on Friday night's showing they could be one of this season's challengers for a Women's Champions League qualification spot.

Superstar-led London City live up to hype as Man Utd suffer

Martin Ho's side laid strong foundations last season in finishing fifth and they have started this campaign strongly with a 3-1 win over West Ham.

Debutant Kirsty Hanson , who they snatched from Aston Villa after she finished as their top-scorer in 2025-26, hit the ground running with two goals in London.

Perhaps the surprise package of the weekend was Liverpool, who have been busy in the transfer window and looked very strong against newly-promoted Charlton.

Tougher challenges will come their way but Gareth Taylor's side oozed confidence and new signing Vivien Endemann was a standout performer in a 4-0 drubbing .

It took them until January last season to pick up a victory as they battled at the bottom of the table - so they have already laid a marker.

"It feels very, very good. We had a clean sheet, scored four goals and won the first match," goalscorer Endemann told Sky Sports.

"Last season, it was really tough, so now to start with a win is very important for us. We want to keep going."

Meanwhile, Crystal Palace's 1-0 victory over Everton proved there is hope for the promoted sides in the expanded 14-team league, despite those losses for Birmingham and Charlton.

Jo Potter's Palace edged in front in the first half thanks to Lexi Lloyd-Smith's finish and held off Everton, whose only shot on target came in stoppage time.

"No words can explain. I'm buzzing. To get to do this in front of my friends and family, it was an unbelievable feeling," said Lloyd-Smith.

"We knew it was going to be hard, we knew we were going into these games as underdogs. It's so good that in the first game we show we're here to put out a statement.

articles.title: Quique exprime el olfato de sus delanteros
articles.standfirst: El Alavés ha marcado en todos los partidos desde la llegada de Quique y alguno de sus delanteros ha visto puerta en 14 de sus 16 encuentros
articles.summary: El Alavés ha marcado en todos los partidos desde la llegada de Quique y alguno de sus delanteros ha visto puerta en 14 de sus 16 encuentros
articles.body: La ilusión reina en Mendizorroza. Los apuros de la recta final del pasado curso han dado lugar a un nuevo horizonte repleto de luz y brillo. Segundo en la tabla con 10 puntos de 12 posibles y la sensación de que las seis semanas de pretemporada han permitido a Quique Sánchez Flores sumar un buen puñado de argumentos al notable nivel que ofreció el equipo desde su llegada al banquillo en el mes de marzo. El crecimiento defensivo del Alavés es una realidad y la producción ofensiva que aumentó desde la llegada del madrileño continúa presente. Tanto es así que es el segundo equipo del campeonato que más goles ha hecho en este inicio de competición, sólo superado por Barcelona. El ‘Glorioso’ promedia dos tantos por partido con Quique (31 en 16 partidos) y no ha fallado a su cita con el gol en ningún partido tras la marcha de Coudet. Todo ello, se debe, en gran parte a la capacidad del preparador madrileño para adaptar el juego a las características de sus delanteros y sacar el máximo provecho a cada uno de ellos. El centro lateral se ha convertido en un argumento que está disparando las opciones de gol del Alavés. De hecho, en el 87% de los encuentros de Quique como babazorro alguno de sus arietes ha visto puerta. Sólo en el empate del pasado curso ante el Villarreal (1-1) y en la derrota frente al Athletic (2-4) los delanteros albiazules se quedaron sin marcar. Toni Martínez fue el héroe de la permanencia con un final de curso para enmarcar y esta temporada son Mariano Díaz y Lucas Boyé los que han asumido protagonismo en forma de goles. El tercer triunfo del curso en Mendizorroza ante Osasuna volvió a llevar la firma de los delanteros. No estaba Toni Martínez por una lesión en el sóleo, pero tampoco eso supuso un problema para el Alavés. Quique formó por primera vez de inicio con Mariano al lado de Lucas Boyéy. Y la apuesta no pudo tener un resultado más satisfactorio. El ariete argentino hizo un ‘hat-trick’ en sus tres remates a puerta y el ex del Real Madrid volvió a acudir a su cita con el gol para hacer la tercera diana del curso. 22 de los 31 goles que ha marcado el Alavés en las 16 jornadas con Quique han sido de alguno de sus delanteros. Toni Martínez suma nueve dianas –todas ellas el pasado curso–, Boyé le sigue de cerca con ocho tantos, Mariano suma tres y Diabaté contribuyó con dos la pasada campaña. El 73% de los tantos babazorros en la ‘era Quique’ son de sus delanteros. Cifras de ensueño para un equipo dispuesto a volar tras un inicio de campaña extraordinario.

articles.title: Everything WMU HC, President Said After Controversial Loss to Michigan, Clock Ruling, More
articles.summary: Many college football fans across the country who were hoping to see an upset are likely blaming the officials for Western Michigan's stunning 13-12 loss to Michigan on Saturday, but Broncos head coach Lance Taylor isn't.
articles.body:
Many college football fans across the country who were hoping to see an upset are likely blaming the officials for Western Michigan's stunning 13-12 loss to Michigan on Saturday, but Broncos head coach Lance Taylor isn't.

"Ultimately the refs did not cost this game, and if we make the mistake of making an excuse it allows us to be bitter instead of getting better, and I think that that's (not) where we want to go as a football team," he told reporters Sunday.

Western Michigan president Russ Kavalhuna also addressed the situation:

Big Ten Addresses Controversial Clock Ruling

It would be easy to blame the officials considering it appeared as if Western Michigan earned a 12-7 win that would have been among the best and most memorable in program history when Michigan quarterback Bryce Underwood's Hail Mary fell incomplete with 0:00 showing on the clock.

While the players started to celebrate, officials eventually put an extra second on the clock and gave the Wolverines one more opportunity.

And they took advantage of that opportunity when Underwood unleashed a second Hail Mary attempt that JJ Buchanan caught to give the home team the victory. The fans then stormed the field after a controversial one-point loss to a MAC team, and the Broncos were left thinking about the upset that wasn't.

The Big Ten released a statement that was accompanied by a video replay and explained Western Michigan's defensive back Micah Davis started his leap from out of bounds and touched the ball with a second remaining.

The statement cited NCAA rule 4-2-3-a that states, "A ball not in player control, other than a kick that scores a field goal, is out of bounds when it touches the ground, a player, a game official or anything else that is out-of-bound or that is on or outside a boundary line."

More notable, though, was the timing aspect since the broadcast of the game appeared to show zero seconds remaining before anyone touched the ball.

The statement addressed that as well and said, "As shown in the provided video of what was viewed during the replay process, a side-by-side view of the play and the game clock, using a direct shot of the game clock in the stadium, was used to determine the final ruling."

The MAC also released a statement that said it reached out to the Big Ten for clarification and said, "The Big Ten explained that the ball touched a player who was out of bounds before the clock reached 0:00, resulting in one additional play being awarded. The Big Ten subsequently provided video and audio of the replay, which confirmed the explanation provided to us."

While Michigan escaped with the controversial win Saturday, it will need to get much better quickly if it wants to have a successful season.

It faces No. 10 Oklahoma in the second game of a schedule that also includes challenging matchups against No. 1 Ohio State, No. 2 Oregon, No. 6 Indiana, No. 18 Penn State and No. 22 Iowa.

If the Wolverines play like they did Saturday the rest of the year, they could be in a struggle to even make a bowl game in Whittingham's first season.

As for Western Michigan, it will look to bounce back from the disappointing loss in Week 2 against Monmouth.

articles.title: Everton 2-2 Man Utd: Ainsley Maitland-Niles - an unlikely Everton hero
articles.summary: Not even Ainsley Maitland-Niles could have imagined his Premier League return for Everton would have played out like it did.
articles.body:
Not even Ainsley Maitland-Niles could have imagined his Premier League return would have played out like this.

Everton 's solution at right-back - a deadline-day signing from Lyon - was on the pitch for less than 20 minutes before being ushered towards the euphoric Toffees supporters after earning a 2-2 draw against Manchester United at Hill Dickinson Stadium.

By marking his first appearance in English football since 2023 with a spectacular strike, the 29-year-old became the first Everton player in eight years to score on his debut.

"From the first day you could feel the energy, the fight and the spirit in the building," Maitland-Niles told BBC Match of the Day.

"It's contagious and it always will be playing for Everton ."

It was only last weekend that Maitland-Niles was an unused substitute in Lyon's 1-1 draw with Le Havre in Ligue 1.

He was into his fourth season with the club, having moved to France after his Arsenal contract expired.

Eight days later he has already made his mark on Merseyside.

There was some bemusement among supporters when Everton announced the arrival of Maitland-Niles, who has endured something of a nomadic career since making his professional debut for Arsenal in a Champions League tie against Galatasaray in 2014.

He had spells on loan at Ipswich, West Brom, Roma and Southampton before finally leaving his boyhood club in 2023.

His move to seven-time French champions Lyon did not pan out the way he would have expected.

Maitland-Niles hoped to finally put to bed the debate over his best position, with the majority of his previous managers viewing him as a versatile figure who could be deployed in defence or attack.

But even after making close to 100 appearances in Ligue 1, he was unable to establish himself as such in France.

Following the retirement of Seamus Coleman at the end of last season, Everton chief executive Angus Kinnear spoke about taking their time to find a replacement.

When they eventually settled on Maitland-Niles, it was not the coup supporters had envisaged after a tedious, summer-long search.

That opinion is sure to have shifted - even if only slightly - after he scored his first Premier League goal in almost seven years on Sunday.

"Our main feeling was we didn't know enough about him since we got him in," said manager David Moyes. "We haven't had much chance to get to know him.

"It was a brilliant goal and a great finish. It's a good start for him and it will help him settle in as well."

Sunday's draw came at the end of a tormenting eight-day period for Everton .

It began during last weekend's 1-1 draw with Bournemouth , when news broke that Everton had accepted a bid from Nottingham Forest for highly rated youngster Harrison Armstrong.

After the travelling supporters made their fury known, the Everton board - led by chairman Dan Friedkin - cancelled the midfielder's move.

But the decision to keep Armstrong meant Everton had to raise funds elsewhere before Tuesday's deadline.

That meant sanctioning the sale of Iliman N'Diaye to Manchester City in a deal worth up to £65m, while striker Beto and right-back Nathan Patterson also departed.

Kinnear's failure to bring in more replacements - a deal for Monaco striker Folarin Balogun collapsed - has left Moyes with only 18 senior outfield players until January at least.

That shortage is expected to be felt particularly in the attacking third, with Everton now relying on the erratic finishing of Thierno Barry.

The Frenchman, who is their top scorer in all competitions this season, spent much of the match against United on the periphery.

By heading over Merlin Rohl's cross towards the end of the first half, Barry took his total for big chances missed to four in the Premier League this term.

"It was a performance which the Everton fans have grown used to from Barry - frustrating at times," former England and Everton striker Wayne Rooney told BBC Sport.

"When he has time on the ball, he can be frustrating and a bit sloppy. He got the one chance and possibly could have done a bit better.

"He's had a good start to the season, but it was quite a typical performance."

Positives from Everton's transfer window

It took two fine strikes - from Tyrique George and Maitland-Niles, to earn Everton a point their performance deserved.

After spending the second half of last season on loan at Everton , George, 20, made his move permanent in July.

The first Premier League goal of his career - a thunderous strike past Senne Lammens at the near post, capped a fine performance.

"He's a young player. Today he was a problem for them at different times," said Moyes.

"His finish was very good when we needed it. He'll continue to improve."

After a week dominated by conversations about what Everton did not do in the transfer window, it was the work of two new arrivals that helped preserve their unbeaten start to the campaign.

articles.title: Este no es el Osasuna de Ramis
articles.standfirst: Los rojillos recibieron cinco goles a causa de un brillante Lucas Boyé
articles.summary: Los rojillos recibieron cinco goles a causa de un brillante Lucas Boyé
articles.body: Si por algo ha destacado Osasuna en estas primeras jornadas de liga es por su solidez defensiva. Un gol en tres jornadas había propiciado un arranque fantástico del conjunto navarro, que sumó siete puntos de nueve posibles. Algo idílico para un entrenador como Luis Miguel Ramis, enfocado por completo en una idea de juego que parte de la base de la portería a cero. Sin embargo, el Alavés y, en especial, Lucas Boyé tenían otros planes. El encuentro en Mendizorroza dejó una imagen de Osasuna endeble y débil en el aspecto defensivo. Prueba de ello no son solamente los cinco goles recibidos, sino la facilidad y poca oposición que han tenido los goleadores en todos y cada uno de los tantos. Ni siquiera un, como siempre, colosal Ante Budimir pudo evitar la tragedia. En resumen, fue un partido para el olvido que se saldó con una “manita” del vecino vitoriano y, para mayor decepción, la cerró uno “de casa” como Pablo Ibáñez. El jugador natural de Mutilva pidió perdón después de anotar gracias a un remate picado con la testa. Definitivamente, si algo está claro es que este Osasuna no es “el Osasuna de Ramis” y que es probable que quede en anécdota para un técnico tan especializado en controlar los partidos desde la zaga.

articles.title: El Málaga necesita al Chupe de Segunda
articles.standfirst: El punta falló un penalti y no está en su mejor momento
articles.summary: El punta falló un penalti y no está en su mejor momento
articles.body: El Málaga no pudo sumar de tres tampoco en su segundo partido como local. Los malaguistas empataron a cero ante el Levante en un choque donde la victoria estuvo en las botas de Chupete. El delantero erró un penalti en el minuto diez que pudo cambiar el signo del partido para los blanquiazules. Un Málaga al que le falta gol y que solo ha anotado un tanto en cuatro jornadas, precisamente desde los once metros con el delantero cordobés como protagonista. Chupete no ha entrado con buen pie en este curso 2026-27. El delantero tuvo un episodio desagradable en el Bernabéu después de discutir el lanzamiento de una falta con Haitam. Los gestos al banquillo y con su compañero le costaron un tirón de orejas por parte de Juanfran Funes. “Hemos hablado con él y con el equipo. El verde habla y, a veces, muchas decisiones las toma el verde. Es una situación en la que ya dijimos cómo se resuelve: cuando entrenamos. Los vínculos que nos unen nos dan la oportunidad de decirnos las cosas con claridad, por eso las entendemos bien”, explicaba en la previa el preparador malaguista. El entrenador de Loja le dio la charla al delantero en la previa del encuentro en un claro guiño al futbolista. El ariete tomó la voz en los momentos previos al encuentro, pero durante el partido volvió a estar poco acertado y apático. Con varias pérdidas de balón y un 59% de acierto en el pase, a Chupete se le vio demasiado inquieto en el césped.

articles.title: Luís Castro: "Hemos tardado en comprender el partido, el punto no es malo"
articles.standfirst: El entrenador portugués del Levante admita que debería haber sido más explícito en el planteamiento del partido
articles.summary: El entrenador portugués del Levante admita que debería haber sido más explícito en el planteamiento del partido
articles.body: El entrenador del Levante, Luís Castro, ha comparecido en rueda de prensa tras el empate sin goles ante el Málaga. El portugués ha matizado que el equipo ha "tardado en comprender el partido, aunque el punto no es malo". Además, ha querido admitir que debería de haber sido más explícito en el planteamiento del choque. Partido sufrido para el Levante. "Hemos empezado bien, tienes una muy clara en el primer minuto de Thiago, y también tienes una de Nacho y otras dos de Brugué, que de normal las hace, pero sabías que ibas a sufrir. en la primera mitad tardamos en hacer los ajustes defensivos y con nuestro planteamiento, ellos han hecho una presión diferente. Tardamos en comprender y en el descanso hemos vuelto hablar con ellos y empezamos mejor en la segunda. En los últimos minutos, ellos han sido mejores, pero en la primera mitad ha estado igualado. En remates hemos estado igual. En su estadio, con la afición, un punto no es malo" Idea de partido y ajustes del descanso. "Cuando miramos el once, sabíamos que iban hacer una cosa diferente. Hemos hablado con ellos para que lo comprendieran. Lo habíamos trabajado. Tal vez, yo debería de hablar de manera diferente con ellos. Desde mi posición, debería de haber sido más explícito, en la segunda parte lo han comprendido y hemos sido mejor en un momento. Al final ellos han sido mejor porque han jugado con corazón y estaban en su casa" Aïssa Mandi en el final. "Le ha dicho al árbitro que un jugador le había pegado aquí (cuello) y que no había pitado falta. Aïssa no le ha hablado mal, se lo ha dicho normal, pero en el fútbol hay ocasiones que algunos jugadores no pueden hablar con los árbitros. Su personalidad y como habla, no ha faltado al respeto ni nada, no le ha dicho ni ladrón ni nada" Cambio de Nacho Pérez. "No es nada. Estábamos teniendo algunos balones por la derecha y estaba llegando bien, pero estaba cansado. Pensábamos que Toljan nos ofrecería más en el juego" Amarilla para Castro. "Yo respeto a todo el mundo y los árbitros pueden equivocarse. Yo hablé con el cuarto arbitro y le he dicho que Toljan no ha sacado porque ha caído un balón de la grada. Por esto me saca tarjeta amarilla. Si entra una persona a por la pelota y saca, igual le saca amarilla al jugador por perder tiempo. Yo solo le he dicho eso y me ha sacado amarilla. Yo he hablado con otros árbitros y le he planteado una actuación del juego y él me dio la razón. Y no pasa nada. Yo hablo con ellos con respeto, siempre. El año pasado me sacaron dos o tres amarillas porque el banquillo era el responsable. Yo respeto a todos y no salto al campo sacando el brazo. Yo les respeto" Valoración de Musuayi y Requena. "Requena ha estado poco tiempo pero ha hecho lo que le pedíamos. Yannis tiene cosas muy buenas, como una que le ha hecho un sombrero y algunos movimientos muy buenos, pero aún se está habituando a la intensidad de la liga. Lo que ha hecho no ha estado mal. No hemos tenido tantas oportunidades pero los dos han estado bien"

articles.title: Quique: “Estamos en la dinámica que merece el equipo y la afición”
articles.standfirst: El Alavés firmó el mejor partido desde la llegada del técnico madrileño en el mes de marzo.
articles.summary: El Alavés firmó el mejor partido desde la llegada del técnico madrileño en el mes de marzo.
articles.body: Quique Sánchez Flores no pudo ocultar su enorme satisfacción tras el contundente triunfo del Alavés sobre Osasuna. El conjunto babazorro acumula tres victorias en sus tres compromisos en Mendizorroza y el técnico madrileño sueña con darle continuidad sin olvidar la importancia de celebrar cada victoria para darle el valor que merece. Análisis: “Se le pueden poner pocos peros a la victoria. Nos hubiese gustado defender un poco mejor el área en el gol, pero hemos estado muy activos, con identidad, con muchas piernas, generando situaciones de gol, haciendo goles preciosos y vibrando con nuestra afición. Es un día maravilloso. Cuando uno trabaja toda la recompensa viene en días como el de hoy. Estamos felices de la comunión que tenemos todos y que los jugadores vayan creciendo”. Disfrutar del momento: “Cuando hay felicidad hay que desbordarla y hay que disfrutarla. La vida es un baile y el baile hay que hacerlo. Estamos en un momento buenísimo y hay que pensar en positivo. Los jugadores están dando su mejor versión y quieren aún ser mejores. Estamos en la dinámica que merece este equipo y la afición”. Claves del histórico arranque: “Las ganas y la ilusión. Cuando uno está felizmente ilusionado es capaz de dar su mejor versión. Todos en este club estamos en esta sintonía. Saboreamos el momento, nos hacemos responsables de cada decisión que tomamos, de la versión de unos jugadores a los les pedimos más y ellos quieren. Es una dinámica que hará crecer al club y ojalá siga adelante”. Inicio de partido: “Con el 5-3-2 queríamos saber dónde nos iban a querer buscar y en qué espacios iban a situarse para generar la superioridad. No era un problema de sistema, sino que de altura defensiva. A veces es difícil convencer a los jugadores que dejando más espacios detrás de la defensa se puede defender mejor, pero de entrada tienes la ventaja de que estás más lejos de la portería. Esto es una convicción y hay que tenerla. En la victoria es más fácil convencer y estas victorias nos están ayudando”. Delantera: “Me alegro mucho cuando marcamos que lo hagan los delanteros. Es importante que chicos como Toni Martínez, Mariano, Boyé o Mañas sumen goles porque dependemos mucho de ellos. Tienen una gran personalidad y sabemos que nos van a responder. Por eso apostamos por dos delanteros”. Mikel Rodríguez: “Echamos mucho de menos a Mikel y le hemos dedicado la victoria. De entrada, nos ha dejado el listón altísimo y sabemos que todo aquel que quiera jugar en esa posición tiene que alcanzar ese nivel”. 10 puntos en 4 jornadas: “Hay que verlo como algo muy positivo y disfrutarlo. Queremos que esta sensación de ser competitivos y capaces no sea algo fugaz. Si asimilamos que con estos resultados estamos haciendo algo especial eso nos contagiará y nos llevará a compartirlo con nuestra gente que es para los que jugamos. Ojalá seamos capaces de solidificar un trabajo con el que nos sentimos reconocidos”.

articles.title: Lamar Jackson Gives Pep Talk in Video to Louisville Ahead of CFB Season-Opener vs. Ole Miss
articles.summary: Lamar Jackson is doing what he can for his alma mater ahead of a highly anticipated showdown with an SEC opponent.
articles.body:
Lamar Jackson is doing what he can for his alma mater ahead of a highly anticipated showdown with an SEC opponent.

The Baltimore Ravens quarterback had a message for Louisville before Sunday's game against Ole Miss and said, "hard work, dedication, you guys have been busting behinds since camp started. All the summer workouts. Now the season's here, let's start the season off right."

Big Ten Addresses Controversial Clock Ruling

Jackson started at quarterback for the Cardinals for three seasons from 2015 through 2017 and took home the Heisman Trophy in his second year when he threw for 3,543 yards and 30 touchdowns to go with 1,571 yards and 21 scores on the ground.

It was a stunning 63-20 victory over No. 2 Florida State early in that season that truly put Jackson on the national radar as a Heisman contender, and this year's Cardinals have a chance to make an early statement as well.

After all, Ole Miss is No. 9 in the country and coming off a College Football Playoff semifinal game.

Defeating a potential SEC contender would be quite the way to start off the season and give Louisville a victory that would carry plenty of weight when the 12-team CFP field is debated.

Jackson will surely be watching to see if his pep talk turns into a victory.

articles.title: Everton 2-2 Man Utd: Gary Neville fearful that Manchester United's liability of conceding goals isn't going away
articles.summary: Man Utd twice led at Everton with goals from Bryan Mbeumo and Benjamin Sesko, but Everton had an answer on both occasions; Ainsley Maitland-Niles struck in added time to rescue a 2-2 draw; Michael Carrick's side have conceded twice in each of their three outings
articles.body:
Michael Carrick insisted his side's start to the season was "not that bad" despite Everton's added-time equaliser in the 2-2 draw left them with just four points from three matches.

Six goals conceded is a big worry. according to Neville, who doesn't see how Carrick can fix it with his current personnel.

Neville said: "It puts a bit of pressure on Manchester United as they have Man City next week and a European game in midweek.

"Michael Carrick is trying to build a trust with his team and with the fans that he can repeat what he did last season.

"That game should have been won today. Everton weren't at it in the first half. They let Everton back into the game.

"They have a liability of conceding goals and it's not going away. That is my fear. Conceding goals will hunt them and chase them down the road. I'm not sure how Carrick will deal with it as he's already got his best back four on the pitch. Why did Shaw and Dalot go off with five minutes to go? Ruben Amorin and Erik ten Hag changed their back four too.

"You can't be changing your back four. There's not much behind the first choice. So you can't change it."

It was Ainsley Maitland-Niles that scored a dream stoppage-time equaliser on his Everton debut, finding the net from 25 yards in spectacular fashion.

Neville admitted it was a fantastic strike but was left frustrated with United's lack of organisation in the build-up to the equaliser.

He added: "Manchester United are conceding two goals a game, you can't concede two goals a game. With the questions asked since the transfer window regarding the defence, United needed to win today and they couldn't concede goals. Lazy analysis will say they conceded two spectacular goals.

"The Maitland-Niles goal is a really bad one.

"Dorgu for some reason chases out and presses, an isolated press. It gets played past Dorgu - it's a massive mistake, a lack of communication. United had to change their back four during the match. Yoro coming on at right-back highlights the problem - he plays so narrow.

"A lot happens before the ball goes in the net. When you're playing away holding onto a result, you have to push up and don't do stupid things. They could have stopped the goal at source. I was screaming as it happened as they had to be organised, they weren't organised in the final few minutes.

"Teams think they have a chance against them. I played in a Man Utd team where teams, in the period between Peter Schmeichel and Edwin Van Der Sar, did feel they had a chance against us at Old Trafford and we weren't quite good enough defensively. Teams have the feeling that they can score. That's a horrible place to be at."

articles.title: Man Utd miss attacking spark against Everton as Ezri Konsa for Arsenal - Premier League hits and misses
articles.summary: The Sky Sports football writers analyse Sunday's Premier League action as Man Utd lack a killer touch against Everton, Ezri Konsa impresses on his first Arsenal start, and Morgan Rogers has a mixed afternoon against the club that tried to sign him
articles.body:
Michael Carrick responded to a question about Manchester United's disappointing start to the season in a relaxed manner. "It's not that bad," he insisted, smiling at the assessment after only three gamed played. He's right to point out how early it is in the campaign.

But what he can't defend is how poorly his side have imposed themselves on two newly promoted teams and Everton. For just the second time in the last 50 years, Man Utd have conceded two goals in each of their first three outings.

None of those opponents - Hull, Ipswich or Everton - are expected to be prolific scorers this term. Carrick's side will face much sterner tests. They play the Manchester derby next weekend, in fact. And have issues at both ends to address before they do.

The spark is missing. Carrick put his head down in sheer disbelief after his side were twice pegged back by worldie strikes at the Hill Dickinson, but the question that needs answering is why Everton were invited back in in the first place. United were the more creative side but often ran out of gas by the final third.

Everton's xG value was greater by the close and they managed double the amount of shots on target (six). The hosts covered more distance and completed more sprints, too.

For all United's control, they lack proper punch and will need to encourage more consistency of output from their expensively-assembled forward line to make up for what they lack defensively. Laura Hunter

Arsenal had given the ball away and Chelsea were breaking through Morgan Rogers down the left.

But soon the Emirates went from anguish to raucous applause as Ezri Konsa came in with a hammer challenge. "A very English tackle," Mikel Arteta said after the game. "You guys love that more than a goal sometimes."

It was the battle between the Aston Villa player Arsenal were going to buy and the Villa player they ended up getting. But after Rogers gave Arsenal a fright after 77 seconds, it was Konsa's time to respond - and he came out on top overall.

It was a moment that announced the £55m signing in front of his new team. It demonstrated the reason why Arsenal went for him, when so many clamoured for more signings further forward.

It also summed up an excellent first start for Arsenal, as Konsa topped a lot of metrics despite playing just 20 minutes of competitive football since the World Cup ended before this Chelsea game.

"I hear they like clean sheets here," Konsa said. He understands the Arsenal assignment. No clean sheet on start No 1 - but he is part of a phenomenal group of Gunners defenders. Sam Blitz

Chelsea's visit to the Emirates Stadium could not have started any better for Rogers. Having spurned the Gunners before choosing Chelsea, he relished his superbly-taken opener after 77 seconds, gesturing towards the badge as he celebrated.

He continued to play with a swagger in the first period, effortlessly pinging a cross-field pass to the feet of Pedro Neto on one occasion and almost adding a second goal when he curled narrowly wide following one of several dangerous forays into the box.

The second half was more difficult. The Arsenal fans loved the crunching tackle from Konsa that left him on the turf and his frustration boiled over when he confronted Declan Rice following an off-the-ball trip during another Chelsea attack.

He wasn't the only Chelsea player whose focus appeared to waver. His goal, added to the one he scored against Fulham, continues a strong start to the season. But he will have to wait for Arsenal's return to Stamford Bridge for a chance to have the final say. Nick Wright

Maybe Everton did have a good Deadline Day after all.

Jack Grealish and Ainsley Maitland-Niles were brought in late, but both made a telling impact as Everton fought back for a 2-2 draw with Manchester United.

Grealish, in particular, provided something Everton had badly lacked. The winger kept driving at United, forcing them backwards. He drew a booking from Diogo Dalot, created two chances and, most importantly, injected some life into an Everton attack that had looked short of inspiration.

There was a swagger to his performance, too. Every time Grealish got the ball, there was a feeling something might happen. Everton finally had a player willing to take responsibility and run at United rather than simply recycle possession.

Then came Maitland-Niles' Hollywood moment.

The new signing popped up with the equaliser to cap a memorable first appearance and rescue a point for David Moyes' side.

Perhaps the business done on Deadline Day was actually masterstroke. Lewis Jones

articles.title: Funes: "Tenemos que persistir, sabíamos que no iba a ser fácil"
articles.standfirst: El técnico sigue siendo positivos pese a las cuatro jornadas sin ganar
articles.summary: El técnico sigue siendo positivos pese a las cuatro jornadas sin ganar
articles.body: Juanfran Funes no escondió cierta sensación de frustración tras el empate sin goles del Málaga CF ante el Levante, aunque el técnico blanquiazul prefirió quedarse con las sensaciones que dejó su equipo sobre el césped de La Rosaleda. El preparador malaguista considera que su equipo fue superior durante prácticamente todo el encuentro, pero reconoce que sigue faltando determinación en los últimos metros. «En el inicio de la segunda mitad nos costó. Salvo eso, hemos dominado el partido al completo. Hemos tenido el doble de entradas al área que ellos, pero eso no cuenta», explicó Funes tras el encuentro. «Te puede servir como camino hacia el gol, pero si no lo hacemos, no nos podemos ir contentos». El entrenador incidió en la necesidad de mejorar la producción ofensiva. «Necesitamos tener esa determinación en el último tercio. Tenemos que persistir, sabíamos que no iba a ser fácil», señaló. Funes considera que el Málaga debe ser capaz de sorprender más a sus rivales y evitar caer en situaciones previsibles cerca del área. «Tenemos que acelerar todo. Ese paso vertical nos dejará sorprender más a los rivales», apuntó el técnico, que destacó también la personalidad mostrada por su equipo en estas primeras jornadas. «Somos nuevos en la categoría y hay que coger confianza. Más que los dos puntos, ellos han visto que pueden ser capaces de competir a los rivales y de hacerlos sentir inferiores». Funes quiso poner en valor el rendimiento del Málaga en La Rosaleda pese a que el casillero de victorias continúa a cero. «Ni Dépor ni Levante pueden decir que han sido superiores aquí. Eso tiene que ser ilusionante para mantenernos firmes», aseguró. «Esto es una maratón y no podemos desfallecer. La adversidad llega, pero hay que mantenerse cabezones hasta el final». El técnico también se refirió a la falta de frescura de algunos jugadores y a una pretemporada que, según reconoció, no se desarrolló en las condiciones ideales. «Nos faltó descanso, un espacio de tiempo más grande para recuperarnos emocionalmente de lo que vivimos. Ya no es tanto en lo físico, hay cosas que hay que asimilar», explicó. Pese a los dos puntos sumados en las primeras jornadas, Funes pidió tranquilidad. «Sabíamos que iba a ser muy duro, no podemos ponernos nerviosos. Lo más importante es que, a pesar de no haber ganado todavía, hemos demostrado que podemos competir bien en esta categoría». En cuanto a los nombres propios, el entrenador confirmó que Juan Cruz fue sustituido por molestias en los gemelos, aunque no espera que tenga una lesión importante. «Se le empezaron a subir los gemelos. Espero que no sea nada, yo creo que no va a ser nada».

articles.title: Ramis: “Hemos cometido demasiados errores”
articles.standfirst: El técnico del equipo rojillo destacó los diversos fallos que derivaron en la goleada recibida por el Alavés
articles.summary: El técnico del equipo rojillo destacó los diversos fallos que derivaron en la goleada recibida por el Alavés
articles.body: Luis Miguel Ramis valoró negativamente, como no podía ser de otra manera, el encuentro de Osasuna en Mendizorroza. El míster rojillo aseguró sobre la goleada que “entrando a valorar de dónde vienen los goles, hasta puede ser merecida” y añadió: “Hemos cometido demasiados errores, sobre todo en zonas del campo en las que tenemos que ser más resolutivos, y eso al final penaliza en Primera División. La sensación que teníamos era que el partido podíamos disputarlo habiéndonos puesto en contra con 2-0. De hecho, hemos hablado de generar más situaciones de centro y en el primer minuto de la segunda parte hemos conseguido acercarnos, pero luego volvemos a cometer un error en dejar a un jugador demasiados metros. No ha sido un buen partido en cuanto a defensa de área se refiere y se encadenan muchas más cosas”. A modo de análisis, se centró en los goles recibidos y destacó: “El primer gol llega en una acción muy sencilla que hace el rival. La segunda es un error que puede ocurrir y que normalmente a Alejandro Catena no le ocurre. Luego, el tercer gol, sí, es un golazo, pero viene de un saque de banda donde no presionamos y dejamos un jugador descolgado, que encima es un delantero que tenía que tener más oposición. Al final llegan dos defensas de centros laterales malas, en las que no chocamos, en las que no referenciamos y el rival los aprovecha. Hemos dejado demasiadas concesiones a un rival que es muy potente en ese tipo de situaciones”. Igualmente, sobre la solidez defensiva que le caracteriza en sus equipos, afirmó que “la volveremos a recuperar” y agregó: “Nosotros siempre logramos sacar muy buenos rendimientos a todo eso, pero a lo mejor se han juntado todos los errores que deberíamos de cometer en un partido en vez de hacerlo en 15 jornadas. Lo normal es que no aparezcan tanto este tipo de situaciones y que seamos mucho más rigurosos en eso. Esto nos sirve para aterrizar, si es que alguno había despegado los pies del suelo, y saber que mañana tenemos que seguir trabajando para preparar el partido del Espanyol”. Además, insistió: “El equipo mentalmente tiene que recuperarse, ya me encargaré yo de eso y de hacer borrón y aprender”. Finalmente, concluyó: “Normalmente el rival tiene que hacer muchas cosas bien para generar las ocasiones de gol. Ahí están los tres partidos anteriores en los que prácticamente Sergio Herrera ha tenido que intervenir muy poco. Y hoy no ha podido intervenir prácticamente en ninguna de las acciones porque han sido goles muy difíciles para el portero. Hoy hemos visto algo que no habíamos visto, que no había pasado y que tenemos que reflexionar para corregirlo porque nos puede pasa”.
